description: Interactive guide for authoring a new DoxieOS agent. Runs inside a builder sandbox at ./.sandbox/builder-agent-N/ (allocated by the DoxieOS Agent Builder UI) and writes the in-progress agent definition to ./.draft/manifest.json so the right-hand preview pane in the UI can render it live. The user iterates with you in plain language; you propose, refine, and persist. When the user clicks Save in the UI, the orchestrator promotes the manifest into the canonical Doxie catalog (.doxie/skills/<id>/{manifest.json,body.md}).
